Name: Auto-Petter Recolor
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Change the color of the "Auto-Petter."
Since it's a Joja machine, I wanted to use Joja colors, but I also added a few other colors.

The default setting is "Vanilla (Game Default)", so please set your preferred color.

Downloads.Description:
Added "Low Chroma Texture" to the ModConfig settings.
Enabling this setting will result in colors that are less saturated than normal. If you are using a recolor mod, using this setting may reduce the sense of incongruity.
